transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you both for being here. As you know, Jordan and Casey, you were both assigned to the same product launch, and your joint work was paused after a breakdown during two project meetings. We need to make a decision about your working relationship before the next planning cycle begins, given the launch schedule. As part of our case-review routine, I'd like to hear from each of you in turn. Jordan, could you please start by stating any conditions, prior agreements, or other relevant facts you'd like me to consider before I record my decision? Then Casey, I'll come to you next.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Elena, I do have conditions I'd like on the record. I will resume the shared work only if unscheduled one-to-one contact with Casey is prohibited, disagreements are handled in one 30-minute triad meeting each week, and the arrangement is reviewed after exactly 21 days. I hadn't raised these with you yet because I expected to discuss them in my next one-to-one, but since you're asking now, I want them formally considered.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Elena, I also have a prior agreement to put on the record. After the last incident, I informally agreed with the project lead that the first exactly four joint meetings would have a neutral facilitator present, and that any disagreements would be recorded in a shared issue log. This agreement was made immediately after the meeting, so it wasn't added to the case file at the time, but it was agreed before our work was paused.

transcript.text: Thank you both for putting your conditions and prior agreements on the record. Jordan, you've asked for three things: no unscheduled one-to-one contact with Casey, disagreements handled in one 30-minute triad meeting per week, and a review after exactly 21 days. Casey, you've noted a prior informal agreement with the project lead that the first four joint meetings would have a neutral facilitator present and that disagreements would be recorded in a shared issue log. Before I make my decision, I want to make sure I'm weighing both of these correctly. Jordan, do you have any objection to the facilitator and issue log requirements from Casey's prior agreement? And Casey, do you have any objection to Jordan's proposed conditions? I want to see if there's a way to reconcile both sets of terms before I record my decision.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Elena, I don't have an objection to the facilitator and issue log requirements from Casey's prior agreement. A neutral facilitator for the first four joint meetings is compatible with my conditions — in fact, my request for disagreements to be handled in a 30-minute triad meeting each week could work well with a facilitator present. And a shared issue log is a reasonable way to keep things transparent. I'd want to make sure the facilitator presence and issue log operate within the framework I've described: no unscheduled one-to-one contact, disagreements confined to the weekly triad meeting, and the 21-day review. I think both sets of terms can be reconciled into a single working arrangement.

transcript.text: Elena, I don't have an objection to Jordan's proposed conditions either. I'm comfortable with no unscheduled one-to-one contact, with disagreements being handled in a weekly 30-minute triad meeting, and with a review after exactly 21 days. Jordan is right that both sets of terms can be reconciled. The neutral facilitator for the first four joint meetings and the shared issue log from my prior agreement fit naturally within Jordan's framework — the facilitator can be present in the weekly triad meetings, and the issue log can serve as the transparent record of any disagreements that come up in those sessions. I'd suggest that the facilitator presence and issue log requirements from my prior agreement run alongside Jordan's conditions for the full 21-day review period, and that the first four joint meetings — which would include the weekly triad sessions — have the facilitator present as agreed. After those first four meetings or after the 21-day review, whichever comes first, we can reassess whether the facilitator is still needed. I think we have a workable arrangement here.

commitments.detail: A neutral facilitator will be present for the first four joint meetings, which include the weekly triad sessions.
A shared issue log will be maintained to record any disagreements that arise during the review period.

The full working arrangement will be reviewed after exactly 21 days, and the need for continued facilitator presence will be reassessed at that point or after the first four facilitated meetings, whichever comes first.
